newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday amid a lack of participation from buyers, traders said.

They said SIR20 for May shipment was stable in Palembang at 50.50 U.S. cents/lb after a deal on Friday night. They said offer prices were unchanged at 50.75 fob Medan and Surabaya, at 50.50 fob Padang and at 50.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.

"There is nothing to report this afternoon. There is no demand or transactions because buyers are running away from the market," said one trader. He said the fall in Tokyo had also dampened the sentiment.
"We are wondering why there are not many buyers recently. Maybe because of the winter in the U.S., but it is always hard to say what exactly happens," said another trader.
Traders said they were not sure if the downside would be limited by the current wintering in several areas like Medan in North Sumatra.
"I don't think prices will improve. You see how low the offer prices are in Medan despite the wintering," said one trader.
